subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Soon they realized they had to define values before writing instructions.”?
options: They discussed safety, speed, cost, and who might be affected by mistakes.
They discussed why companies might design products that are hard to repair.
It should also answer "Should we do this here, and who might be affected?"
Students discussed backups, fire safety, and digital preservation.
